headline: First week of housing loan interest subsidy policy: borrowers to save nearly 40,000 yuan over 5 years
summary: In the first week of China's housing loan interest subsidy policy, borrowers are set to save nearly 40,000 yuan over five years, according to the report.
why: Mortgage interest subsidies lower household borrowing costs and are a tool used by Chinese authorities to support the property market and household demand.
